problems.title: Live ticks rebuild things that look the same
problems.cause: Every price packet rebuilds a whole watchlist row, even when it changed only fields the row does not show; the header wealth tile rebuilds twice per holdings tick; new tick streams are created on every build of the list and the indices rail.
problems.effect: 185.5 % CPU on an idle Bench 20 list (C1) and 49.5 % of idle frames identical to the previous one (U5).

problems.title: The header wealth tile animates every 3 seconds
problems.cause: MO Wealth / External Wealth flip with a 500 ms page animation every 3 s for as long as the header is mounted, which is always on the watchlist.
problems.effect: About 60 frames every 3 s, roughly half of the 39.6 fps idle redraw (U4, verify); also the header shift users notice.

problems.title: Scrolling down rebuilds the whole header every frame
problems.cause: The list emits a new header-pin state on every scroll update and the header BlocBuilder rebuilds the landing header, indices rail, tab bar and banners each time; the whole screen also rebuilds on each list update; the app renders through a texture view on Android 11+.
problems.effect: 75.3 fps while scrolling on a 120 Hz screen, about 63 % of offered frames, although jank is only 0.34 % (S5, S1).

problems.title: Rows are recreated on every update and leak listeners
problems.cause: Keys are created in build, so every list update unmounts and remounts every row; each row leaves a stream subscription and three tooltip controllers behind; the cubit is app-scoped, so leftovers live for the session.
problems.effect: +60.0 MB over 10 open/close cycles (R9) and 380.5 MB after 5 min (R3).

problems.title: Offline and stale prices look live
problems.cause: The only offline message is gated on a bottom-bar index the RISE shell does not appear to set; rows use the same style online and offline; the connectivity listener stops after the first background.
problems.effect: Offline score 44.4 (O1): no banner, no last-updated marker, stale prices after a return from background (U3).

problems.title: Release builds write user data and noise to logcat
problems.cause: CleverTap events are printed with print; every cached response is printed; an 'API Failed' line is written before every response; the logged URL doubles the origin; the committed HEAD still prints the bearer token.
problems.effect: Client code, holdings data and misleading errors in release logcat (creation notes); extra string conversions on every API call.
